sourceDetail: Historical calibration dry-run from read-only Sleeper transactions using current Trade Analyzer talent/surplus/FAAB/roster-tax formula.

model.name: current-tradeFairnessEngine-visible-formula
model.formula: netValue = deltaTalent + deltaSurplus * 0.6 + deltaFaab * 0.05 - rosterTax; gap = max(netValue) - min(netValue)

notes: Local candidate only; historical_distribution was not written.
Exact commissioner reversal transactions are excluded from the recommended approved calibration set.
Player values come from the local FantasyCalc + River City keeper-cost player_stats candidate snapshot.
